label: preparing
what: Innkeeper and local tradespeople are jointly preparing an evening great-hall meeting and presentation, with substantial bread catering, initially requesting secrecy and the mayor's arrival precisely at eighteen. Freight arranges grain funding, baker will bake eighty-two remaining loaves, and builder is coordinating supplies. Secretary knowingly helps with hall access and scheduling, while insisting the mayor be informed. A surprise marking the mayor's forty years of service is plausible but not confirmed; the presentation's actual purpose remains undisclosed.
